# Sudheer Palakurla — AI Engineer

> Portfolio for Sudheer Palakurla, an AI Engineer with 8+ years of full-stack engineering experience.

## Recruitment

Sudheer is exploring full-time AI Engineer, Applied AI Engineer and LLM Engineer opportunities. He is based in London, United Kingdom, with a one-month notice period. His Skilled Worker visa is valid until 2029. Employer sponsorship is required for a new full-time position. These details were confirmed by the owner.

The eight-plus years refer to full-stack development experience, not eight years specifically in AI. Professional experience precedes the AI case studies. Additional website examples are available in an expandable collection. The current official job title remains Web Designer, with AI and application engineering responsibilities described separately.

## About

Sudheer builds production AI systems and the products around them: retrieval augmented generation, LLM routing with failover, agentic workflows, real-time voice AI, React applications, APIs and cloud deployment.

- Delivered or contributed to 95+ client web and e-commerce builds.
- Led migrations reporting 30–40% improvements in performance and maintainability.
- Introduced testing associated with approximately 40% fewer production defects.
- Built an independent AI SaaS platform as sole engineer.
